Clinical Indication: The patient was referred for family history of first-degree relative with crc at age 48. Informed consent was obtained and a time-out was completed with RN Sawsan Darwish.

Procedure Description: Under Entonox (Nitrous Oxide) on demand - unsedated protocol, a digital rectal exam was unremarkable. Using the Fujifilm EC-760ZP-V/L high-definition colonoscope: Scope inserted per rectum and advanced without undue difficulty. Examination of the colonic lumen was performed during slow withdrawal. Initial views were obscured by murky effluent (initially appearing poor), but after extensive washing and aspiration during withdrawal, bowel preparation was upgraded to good/adequate in all segments.

Mucosal Evaluation and Specimens: No polyps identified. Mild patchy erythema and loss of vascular pattern noted in the rectosigmoid; targeted mucosal biopsies (Jar 1) were taken with cold biopsy forceps. MICROSCOPIC DIAGNOSIS: Colon, random biopsies: Lymphocytic colitis (>20 IELs per 100 surface epithelial cells). Negative for malignancy.

Complications: None immediate. Patient discharged from recovery in stable condition.
